question: "gate never fires on Campus" vs RAPT_FULL 4 retrains / RAPT_T2 2 retrains
resolution: RAPT_T2 (Table III rung 1) has no fingerprint gate. RAPT_FULL adds the gate; on Campus the gate fires (A5_gate: RAPT-Gate-Orig gate_accept=9, gate_reject=3 per seed), so RAPT_FULL rejects some reuses and retrains 4 times vs 2 for RAPT_T2 (Final_Experiments summary_full: retrains column). The 'gate never fires' claim is false for the Campus ladder. In the revalidation v2 A1 harness the Table-II RAPT controller has NO gate at all (rapt_9a.py RAPTSystem), which is a separate code path.
